chapterPath: 0039 - Chapter 1096 - To be a gag gift, or not a gag gift, that is the question. - A worried Jake/chapter.txt
currentParagraphText: “What’s your personal opinion on the matter?” Jake asked. “Would you personally take on a slave?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “What’s your personal opinion on the matter?” Jake asked. “Would you personally take on a slave?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I believe that depends on your definition of the word,” Artemis shook her head, with Jake beginning to feel a bit nervous with that answer. “I reckon Vitesse is the cause of this question? I personally wouldn’t classify her as a slave. There’s no contract and no forced compulsion. However, from an outside point of view, the distinction doesn’t seem to matter much. She pledged her life to me, swearing she would serve me eternally for sparing her life. I have clarified her debt is paid, but her oath still binds her. I personally view her more as a servant now, and most of the time, she’s free to do as she wants to, and it isn’t as if her life is bound to mine. One day, perhaps she will feel that her debt is paid, at which point she will leave, but I don’t know when that will be, so until then, she is effectively a slave of her own oath.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: He didn’t feel completely satisfied with her answer, though.
